final.memo:
We have been patient, but our thesis regarding a recovery at Star Gas is being undermined by a management team that acknowledges its failure to centralize service and dispatch without providing a clear or actionable remedy. The 6.5% annual attrition rate is unacceptable, and the loss of volume to both conservation and competitors suggests the core franchise is eroding faster than the balance sheet can support. [D02], [D03]

Management has shown an inability to manage the business through this transition, and we are no longer content to wait while customer relationships continue to deteriorate. The propane disposal has occurred, yet the benefits are opaque, and there is a real risk that senior creditors will erode the equity cushion if the status quo remains. [D04], [D05]

We are escalating our position to force a change in leadership and governance. It is time for a board that understands that service quality and customer retention are the only levers that matter in this business. We expect a concrete plan for operational improvement immediately, or we will take our case to the broader shareholder base to ensure our capital is not further wasted by the current regime. [D03], [D07]
